newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Biper sets $20-30 mln IPO for June 19-20.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Biper sets $20-30 mln IPO for June 19-20.

text.p: Mexico's Biper SA de CV, a company offering beeper services, plans an initial public offering on the mexican exchange's small cap market on June 19 and 20, a market source said..

An official at BBV-Probursa, who is lead manager of the deal, said that the share price offer range would be between 2.30 and 2.70 pesos. Biper plans to offer between 15 and 20 percent of the company's share capital, raising $20-$30 million.
The share offering will be held on the Mexican bolsa's intermediate market, its forum for small-cap stocks.

Biper has been in operation three years. The source said the National Securities and Banking Commission said it would be a much slower share offer process if Biper were to launch on the main market because of the age of the company.

The official, who did not wish to be named, said Biper plans to use 50 percent of the capital raised to pay down long term debt. "The rest will be used to continue expansions in Mexico...and Central America," the source added.
Biper currently operates in 80 cities around Mexico and plans to open in 12 more cities following the share offer.
New plans are also to launch services in El Salvador and in the Dominican Republic. The company started beeper service in Guatemala City late last month.

The BBV-Probursa source said Biper also planned to launch a new voice pager service. "The voice pager is a beeper with a portable recorder via which voice messages will be received," the source added.
